description: List Garmin activities in a date range, newest first: ID, type, local start time, distance, duration, pace (or speed), average / max heart rate, elevation gain, training effect, training load and fastest splits (1 km … marathon, when long enough). Defaults to the last 7 days. Use the returned id with garmin_get_activity for heart-rate zones, running dynamics, intervals and RPE. With group_by "week", returns totals per week instead (count, distance, time, elevation, training load, minutes per HR zone, longest activity; `summary` covers full weeks only), for volume over a training block. Weekly totals cover up to 100 activities per call.

activity_type.description: Garmin activity type key, e.g. running, trail_running, treadmill_running, cycling, road_biking, walking, hiking, strength_training, lap_swimming.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in the user's time zone.

group_by.description: Return weekly totals instead of activities. Weeks start on the user's first day of the week; limit and offset don't apply.

offset.description: Skip this many activities, for paging with next_offset.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date.

name: garmin_search_activities
title: Search Garmin activities
